title: Spaced-repetition for 5-a-day (Leitner / SM-2)
summary: Leitner-box scheduler over G5's 5-a-day skill list. Reads G1's correct/incorrect log; advances correct skills to the next box, demotes incorrect skills to box 1. Each day's 5-a-day pack is weighted by box (60% box 1 / 30% box 2 / 10% box 3+).

in: client/src/lib/leitnerScheduler.ts (new, ~150 LoC) — pure scheduler; reads pupil_attempt rows; emits per-pupil per-skill { box: 1|2|3|4|5, lastReviewed }
client/src/lib/fiveADayBuilder.ts (G5) — extend with optional schedulerOutput input that biases the day's pack accordingly
shared/aiSchemas.ts — additive: metadata.spacedRepetitionState?: { skill: string, box: number, lastReviewed: string }[]
Targeted vitest: scheduler advances/demotes correctly; pack weighting respects box distribution; deterministic
out: SM-2 algorithm (deferred — Leitner is simpler and good enough for v1; SM-2 is Phase I if usage demands it)
Cross-day pack streaming (deferred — v1 emits the pack per day on demand)

acceptance_criteria: Scheduler is pure: same pupil_attempt rows → same box state across runs.
Correct attempt on a skill in box N moves it to box N+1 (capped at 5); incorrect demotes to box 1.
5-a-day pack with scheduler bias respects 60/30/10 distribution within ±10%.
Skills not yet attempted default to box 1.
